text: another thing. the land turbines basically borrowed everything from jet engines, single crystal and coatings showed up in military engines first and trickled down to power plants a decade later. so the credit question is partly a defense budget question?? also the blades are consumables, a hot section overhaul is a huge chunk of what an operator pays over the life of the plant. every extra 50 degrees probably eats blade life. maybe the real limit isn't physics or NOx but who pays for the overhauls
